Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when Driver 2 attempted to change
lanes into the same space and made contact with the left rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle. The contact was a
sideswipe and both vehicles remained upright after the collision. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel at the time,
and a Passenger was also present in the vehicle. Responding officers spoke with both drivers, the Passenger, and
two independent witnesses, all of whom gave accounts consistent with the sequence of events described at the
scene. Photographs taken at the location show scrape marks and dented body panels on the left rear of Driver 1's
vehicle and a matching area of damage on the right front of Driver 2's vehicle. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle
was noted or reported. Driver 1 stated having pain in the neck and lower back shortly after the impact and was
evaluated at the scene. The reported symptoms are consistent with the forces typically involved in a collision of this
type. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
